purpose: Determine, for every currently admitted historical domain, what kind of temporal authority actually backs its known-at claim. The audit never converts a capture or retrieval timestamp into a historical known-at instant, and it never treats a conservative bound as an observed final whistle.

authority_classes.OBSERVED_PUBLICATION_TIMESTAMP: The source itself states when the value was published, and that instant is captured verbatim.
authority_classes.OBSERVED_EFFECTIVE_TIMESTAMP: The source itself states the instant from which the value was in effect, which may differ from its publication instant.
authority_classes.CONSERVATIVE_PRECOMMITTED_AVAILABILITY_B: No instant is observed, but a bound is logically guaranteed by evidence the source does carry, is precommitted in this contract before any evaluation, is reproducible from that evidence alone, and is labeled as a bound.
authority_classes.RETRIEVAL_TIMESTAMP_ONLY: The only temporal evidence is when this project retrieved the value, which is not a historical known-at instant.
authority_classes.POSTGAME_ONLY_EVIDENCE: The value cannot exist before the contest it describes has been played.
authority_classes.SOURCE_ABSENT: No source for the domain has been acquired.

conservative_bound_policy.label: THIS_IS_A_BOUND_NOT_AN_OBSERVED_FINAL_WHISTLE

date_only_rule.applies_when: The only temporal evidence for a contest is a calendar date, observed as a midnight UTC sentinel in the spine start field.
date_only_rule.logical_guarantee: A recorded calendar date may be a local date, so the true contest window lies within one day either side of it. Adding one further day covers the longest possible contest including overtime and weather suspension. A prior contest is therefore guaranteed complete before a target contest starts only when the target date is at least three days after the prior date.

published_start_instant_rule.applies_when: The spine carries a non-midnight UTC start instant for the contest.
published_start_instant_rule.logical_guarantee: A published start instant plus twelve hours bounds any contest including overtime, television delay and weather suspension. A prior contest is guaranteed complete before a target contest starts when the prior start instant plus twelve hours does not exceed the target start instant.

rejected_assumptions: Treating the retrieval time of a historical capture as the moment the value became known.
Treating a recorded calendar date as an exact kickoff instant.
Assuming that a prior contest on the immediately preceding calendar day had finished before a target contest began.
Imputing a poll publication instant from a poll week ordinal.

publication_time_routes.hypothesis: The national governing body statistics surface publishes rankings with an as-of or release instant that could establish an observed publication timestamp for the rankings domain.
The publisher of record for the Associated Press Top 25 exposes per-article publication instants that could establish an observed publication timestamp for a poll release.
